title: El precio del imperio
goal: Read the paradox at the center of the colonial economy: the silver that reached Spain paid war debts rather than building industry, prices rose across Europe, and the benefits stayed unequally distributed in America.
grammar: Voz pasiva: consecuencias de la economía colonial

items: Explain why American wealth didn't translate into lasting development for Spain.
Explain what the 'price revolution' was and what caused it.
Describe how Spain used much of the silver to pay war debts to Genoese and Flemish bankers.
Explain how the benefits of the colonial economy were distributed.
Use a chain of passive-voice sentences to synthesize economic consequences.
